image_description: A vertical traffic light suspended from a horizontal metal arm against a clear blue sky. The housing is dark and rectangular with rounded corners, containing three circular signal lenses. The bottom lens is illuminated green. The top two lenses appear dark/off. Visors extend over each lens. The mounting hardware connects the light to the overhead arm.
